name: @unicorn-studio/capture
description: Unicorn Capture — desktop snap tool that auto-categorizes screens by route/state/session for the Unicorn Studio gallery platform. Forked from Prisma.

scripts.build: PATH="$PWD/scripts/binshim:$PATH" electrobun build && bash -c 'for a in build/*/*.app; do bash scripts/ensure-signed.sh "$a"; done'
scripts.build:stable: PATH="$PWD/scripts/binshim:$PATH" electrobun build --env=stable && bash scripts/ensure-signed.sh "build/stable-macos-arm64/Unicorn Studio.app"
scripts.build:signed: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f .env.build ] && source .env.build; set +a; PATH="$PWD/scripts/binshim:$PATH" electrobun build --env=stable' && bash scripts/ensure-signed.sh "build/stable-macos-arm64/Unicorn Studio.app"
scripts.release: bun run build:signed && bun run release:publish:stable
scripts.ci: biome check src/ && PATH="$PWD/scripts/binshim:$PATH" electrobun build
